name: Terrain Hopper
body:
You can shift between two of your dominions in different terrains.

Prerequisite(s): Terrain dominance class feature, at least two terrain dominances.

Benefit(s): You can plant one pennant with your personal symbol in a place within each of the terrains you selected for the terrain dominance class feature.

You cannot plant more than one pennant in each terrain. Once per day, you may teleport yourself and creatures in contact with you to one of your pennants, as greater teleport or plane shift. This is considered a spell-like ability and doesn’t work if the pennant you want to reach was dislodged from its place.
